close_reason: JMAP-ptl.20: fixed via clippy --fix. JMAP-ptl.21: labeled opinion, existing iterator chains are already good. JMAP-ptl.7: documented architectural choice — in-process filter chosen over query_objects delegation due to tree-mode complexity
description: Throughout the handlers (mailbox.rs:57, thread.rs:51, identity.rs:52, etc.), Id values are converted to JSON strings via id.as_ref().to_string(). Since id.as_ref() returns &str, calling .to_string() on a &str is equivalent to .to_owned(). Clippy lint clippy::str_to_string warns against .to_string() on &str and suggests .to_owned() for clarity (to_string() is for types implementing Display; to_owned() is for converting a borrowed str to an owned String). This is minor but noisy if clippy is run with -D warnings on a future Rust edition.
title: Multiple .map(|id| Value::String(id.as_ref().to_string())) calls: .to_owned() vs .to_string()
